name: Luz Rivas
stance: Opposed the federal moratorium on state AI laws in the 2025 budget bill and the defense bill, and wants the House in session to address AI risks.

statements.text: This provision would halt innovation and block states’ abilities to protect Americans from current and future AI challenges.

This dangerous provision would have stymied AI innovation and prevented states from protecting their residents from current and future challenges. I led an amendment in the House to remove this provision, but @HouseGOP prevented it from getting a vote.
Led, with Rep. Doris Matsui, more than 75 colleagues in opposing the inclusion of an AI moratorium on state laws in the defense bill.
Joined more than 80 House Democrats in writing to Speaker Johnson urging him to keep the House in session to address the risks posed by AI.
Called for responsible AI safeguards, a federal strategy for emerging technologies and stronger oversight of the AI industry.
